description: Produces developer integration recipes for the Learnosity Author API. The client describes an integration design — which authoring experience to embed (item editor, item browser, activity editor, activity list) and how it's configured (allowed widget types, editor options, item bank) — and L0177 validates it, flags holes (missing required properties like the serving domain, the author user id, or the item reference) as steering warnings, and via get_spec returns a host-language-neutral recipe: goal, preconditions, procedure, gotchas, and runnable verification steps. It does NOT author item content (that is L0176) and does NOT emit runnable code.

example_prompts.prompt: How do I embed the Learnosity item editor in my LMS for author u123 on lms.acme.edu, allowing only MCQ and cloze questions?
example_prompts.notes: Names the experience (item editor), the serving domain, the author identity, and restricts what authors may add — which becomes question-type-groups, the one restriction the Author API is confirmed to enforce.

example_prompts.prompt: I want to embed a Learnosity item browser so my authors can find and open existing items.
example_prompts.notes: The item_list view; the recipe covers signing + wiring, and warns that domain and user id are still needed.

example_prompts.prompt: How do I embed the Learnosity activity editor so instructional designers can assemble activities from our item bank?
example_prompts.notes: The activity_edit view; reference is optional (new vs existing activity).

example_prompts.prompt: Let authors edit item algebra-item-1 but not delete widgets, restricted to short text and formula questions.
example_prompts.notes: Sets a reference, a widget permission (no delete), and limits the question types offered — the recipe's verification checks each, differentially.
